headline: Huge Public Assets Return to the State as Further Major Changes Approach
summary: Liquidation of 16 public-interest asset management foundations is complete, returning public assets worth at least HUF 1,284 billion to direct state control. The government says it has met EU Recovery and Resilience Facility commitments tied to nearly HUF 3,650 billion.
why: The EU Recovery and Resilience Facility channels post-pandemic funds to member states, and access depends on meeting agreed reform milestones.
